text.tspan: A. Closed loop and simulation support
A109, A117, A110, A323, A113C: one CO₂ + temperature sensor per room;
one ventilation + heating actuator per room. Sensors/counts: every 2 s wall.
Read responses are dashed; requests/messages/writes are solid.
MQTT uses QoS 1; commands/states/plans/health are retained.
Physics uses the shared clock, reached states and occupancy.
Truth is sampled through device lag/noise/faults; the boundary is by convention.
Sensors also write display values; actuators report state/target/motion/fault.
Physics energy counters are HTTP truth, not an automatic MQTT archive.
